translations.web: I will sow them among the peoples; and they will remember me in far countries; and they will live with their children, and will return.
translations.bsb: Though I sow them among the nations, they will remember Me in distant lands; they and their children will live and return.
translations.kjv: And I will sow them among the people: and they shall remember me in far countries; and they shall live with their children, and turn again.
